description_en: small cocoon sorting box with woven exterior and empty rounded internal compartments; front scooped edge, right side handle, rear rigid panel
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image is the canonical FRONT. Render ONE photorealistic REAR azimuth180, opposite face of THAT EXACT SAME OBJECT, rotating only the camera. Plain tall rear panel nearest camera, scooped front edge on far side. Four 2x2 circular cavities, existing right handle now image-left. Keep exact material, finish, weave, dimensions, bindings, handles, cavities and natural resting/display pose of the reference. Match sensible elevation, warm-white seamless background, soft light, scale and framing. Whole object centered with margins. No three-quarter azimuth, mirroring, detached objects, props, people, food, animals or plants. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermark or measurements.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
